ci_attestation_subject: ADP V0.2 P08 / T063 research metadata production deploy + worker build-stamp guard
summary: ADP V0.2 P08 implements task T063 (research metadata enrichment) and wires it into the daily cron: board1/board2 paper items now carry OpenAlex metadata (preprint vs journal, venue, citation count, open access). T063's two acceptance clauses hold. Clause 1, preprints not conflated with journals: type=='preprint' OR source.type=='repository' -- it must be OR, since eLife measures as preprint+journal. Clause 2, enrichment failure must not block the original paper: enrichMeta and attachMeta are wholly wrapped; this clause is currently being exercised for real in production, because the cron has not run since deploy so cn_item_meta does not exist, every page load hits a genuine D1 no-such-table error inside attachMeta, and every route still returns 200 with real content. The implementation NEVER claims a work is a research paper: OpenAlex reports Nature news and PNAS In This Issue as type=article/is_paratext=false/venue=Nature|PNAS, indistinguishable from real research, so only OpenAlex's own fields are transcribed. Root governance was touched only to register the three ADP canonical governance blob OIDs this sync changed. Also adds a guard that the worker's self-excluding BUILD stamp reproduces -- nothing enforced it before, so an unstamped edit made /build.json report a source that was not running, and every review that uses the stamp to prove 'no code changed after sign-off' was reasoning from an unverified premise. release_mode PRODUCTION; live 659d32fd39da -> ac7cf4800e18.

test_results.command: P08 acceptance (runs the SHIPPED metaDoi/enrichMeta/attachMeta/metaFacts against a REAL node:sqlite DB loading the REAL schema_cloud.sql)
test_results.observed: exit 0, 39 assertions. Adapters resolve all 9 live source id/url forms to the right DOI and abstain (null) on the 7 that have none. Clause 1: arXiv/bioRxiv preprint=1, NEJM/Nature-Comms preprint=0, repository alone suffices, and no output ever contains 研究论文. Clause 2: network throw / HTTP 500 / malformed JSON / dead D1 all degrade without throwing. Dedup: one duplicated DOI requested once and broadcast to both items, 1 external subrequest. DIR-007: 300 candidates -> 1 subrequest of 50 DOIs. Not-found bookkeeping is behavioural (a fresh miss is not re-requested; it IS retried once enriched_at ages past META_RETRY_DAYS).

test_results.result: PASS (all 12 load-bearing, none decided by a crash)
test_results.observed: nc1..nc11 incl. nc6a/nc6b: every revert reds for its stated semantic, 崩溃=0, each reaches the final verdict. Shipped code exit 0. Fixture uses ANALYZE (stricter than production D1, which has no ANALYZE); verified no assertion's PASS depends on statistics, so no green claims anything production does not guarantee.

4 tests. Load-bearing: editing META_SCAN 200->201 without re-stamping -> FAIL. Before this guard, source_sha256 appeared NOWHERE in tests/ or .github/workflows/ -- an unstamped edit shipped a /build.json that lied about which source was running, and the stamp is the exact mechanism six adversarial review rounds used to prove no code changed after sign-off.

stop_conditions: 首次 cron 后必须实查 cn_item_meta 是否真的有行：env.DB.batch([SELECT,SELECT]) 是全仓唯一一处 batch 跑 SELECT，无仓内先例；若 D1 的 D1Result[] 契约与文档不符，results 会为空 -> enrichMeta 静默什么都不补、不报错、不降级 —— 正是本项目最怕的『看着绿、其实什么都没做』。
若要提高 META_BATCH，先重读 known_gaps §5：50 是我们自己的保守取值，OpenAlex 的 doi OR 上限实测是 100。

rollback.production: npx wrangler@4 versions deploy <previous-version-id> 回到 659d32fd39da。
rollback.repo: git revert 本 commit；cn_item_meta 独立成表、cn_items 从未被改写，故回滚不损失既有数据。

unresolved_risks: env.DB.batch([q1,q2]) 读 SELECT：全仓唯一一处，正确性依据是 Cloudflare 文档的 D1Result[] 契约而非仓内先例。首次 cron 后必须实查。
未强行绕过 runDaily 的幂等守卫去验证 enrichMeta：绕过需删当天 cn_run_log 行，会连带重跑 ingestAll/selectDaily 并可能改掉 Owner 已发布的当日精选。故首次真实执行在下一次 cron（30 20 * * * UTC）。
响应侧去重规则（取 cited_by 最大者）只在一对真实重复上验证过；理论上被撤稿/paratext 的重复记录若引用数更高会胜出。影响面有界：代码只逐字转述 OpenAlex 字段、从不合成标签，最坏是被引数字错，不是捏造身份。
『每晚约 600 行』不是硬上界：prune 豁免被 cn_reviews/cn_selections/cn_lessons 引用的条目，受保护行会越过 KEEP_PER_BOARD 累积（估每年 +1k，十年后仍 < 5M/天 的 0.3%）。
nc7 的检出力依赖 fixture 的 ANALYZE，而生产 D1 无 ANALYZE：即 ORDER BY 在今天的生产计划下未被测到（按设计如此——测的是契约，不是 planner 的运气）。
